title: Visualize This
text: You can now ask Amp to visualize or build something for you and it will do it, right in the thread: charts, timelines, diagrams, and mockups you can click through. Here are some examples, from our real threads. Go ahead, hover and click through them: Open the post on ampcode.com to see the chart of last month's commits that Amp drew.
